name: SBCheatGUI Item Policy Database
description: Central safety policy for the Qt Item Add Center. Live Add is foregrounded for guarded stack categories; Save Backup edits existing count-backed save records.

levels.SAVE_ONLY: Likely safe if already in save

Item_Gold.detail: Gold maps through wallet-style save data. Validate and use Save Backup reports; Live Add stays blocked for wallet routes.

Item_Gold+.detail: Gold Pack maps through wallet-style save data. Validate and use Save Backup reports; Live Add stays blocked for wallet routes.

Item_Gold++.detail: Gold Pack (Large) maps through wallet-style save data. Validate and use Save Backup reports; Live Add stays blocked for wallet routes.

GearCore.detail: Gear Core can appear as a counted save record, but it is progression-adjacent. Validate before editing.

BodyCore.detail: Body Core is progression-sensitive and is blocked from duplication.

BetaCore.detail: Beta Core is progression-sensitive and is blocked from duplication.

AlphaCore.detail: Alpha Core is progression-sensitive and is blocked from duplication.
